title: stage post-processing
shortDescription: A Stage2D with a bloom post-pass through a RenderPipeline on its StageRenderer
description: The smallest post-processing setup of the stage layer: a three.js `RenderPipeline` goes into `StageRenderer.pipeline`, a node builder into `StageRenderer.buildOutputNode`, and the stage is drawn through both. The builder comes from `createBloomOutputNodeBuilder({strength, radius})` and lays a bloom over the rendered scene. Eighty tinted sprites circle in an `OnStageUpdateFrame` handler, so the glow has something to smear.
